notes.title: Changed Release Date
notes.notes:
I really didn't want to do this and went back and forth about whether to delay the release or not. On one side the income for cash flow would have been really helpful to release sooner, but there are several things that can be farther along like the online multiplayer and special modes for that.

Minigolf Blast will be released in October right after the Steam Next Fest that happens in the fall.

There will be a new demo build out soon.

And at some point this summer and into the fall there will some beta tests to test some new game modes and see how many people can play at the same time in the online mode. You will be able to find out about getting access to beta builds on my Discord channel. The channel is a work-in-progress right now.

Discord channel:  https://discord.gg/bQB7xzQube


Anyway, that is the latest. Been making good tech progress. Really want to get this thing out the door and make sure it is fun.

Kevin

notes.title: Mighty Knights Progress, Minigolf Blast Release Date/Price, & Home Improvement
notes.notes:
[h1]Minigolf Blast[/h1]

Tentative Release Date: July 6, 2023
Tentative Price: $7.99

This will be an Early Access release. Lots of holes and courses are already complete. The minigolf courses that are you done will be completed with input from the community.


[h2]Mighty Knights[/h2]

Progress is being made on Mighty Knights (lol... fixed typo... wrote that as Nighty Knights). The user interface and various other things are being fixed up and puzzles are being made. Mid-March release looks to be tough to achieve - we'll see. The sooner the better.
